metadata.title: Create iOS Auto-Renewable Subscription
metadata.description: Step-by-step guide to creating auto-renewable subscriptions in App Store Connect for the native-purchases plugin.

blocks.text: Auto-renewable subscriptions provide recurring access to content, services, or premium features in your iOS app. This guide walks you through creating subscriptions in App Store Connect.
Auto-renewable subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each billing period until users cancel. They're perfect for:
Have an active Apple Developer Program membership
Complete banking and tax information in App Store Connect
In App Store Connect, select your app and go to
Select your subscription group or create a new one if needed.
icon next to your subscription group to add a new subscription.
: Descriptive name for your internal use (not shown to customers)
: Unique identifier for this subscription (cannot be changed later)
Use descriptive, lowercase names with underscores
Required for configuring the native-purchases plugin
Select the subscription duration from available options:
The duration determines how often users are billed.
: Select your primary market (usually your country)
Apple automatically converts to other currencies
Consider perceived value and market rates
Decide whether to enable Family Sharing, which allows up to 6 family members to access the subscription.

:::caution
Once Family Sharing is enabled, it cannot be turned off for this product.
